title: ncarnate: Convert HDF4/HDF-EOS2 (MODIS, AMSR-E) to CF-annotated netCDF4 and losslessly recompress netCDF/HDF5
description: A Python library and command-line tool for converting HDF4/HDF-EOS2 granules to CF-annotated netCDF4 and losslessly recompressing netCDF/HDF5. Version 2.3.0 adds explicit-output prepared jobs, digest-verified resume, streamed copying and verification, tiled swath interpolation, and optional isolated conversion workers with OS-enforced memory limits on Windows and Linux. Outputs are verified value-for-value before publication. Generated coordinate fields can still require whole arrays, and the worker limit excludes the calling process.
